problem.question: Find a Schmidt-rank-at-most-two vector with negative expectation on (I - (1/2) |Omega><Omega|) tensor-powered 5 times, for unnormalized Omega=sum_i |ii> in local dimension 3.
problem.scope: Tests distillability of this state at this copy count. The search covers sparse real integer factors. Larger copy counts, complex factors, and the existence of all-copy NPT bound entanglement are separate questions.

prompt:
Design one bounded computational experiment. Return integer search parameters as JSON. For sphere instances maximize the lower bound and minimize the upper bound. degree is the Legendre LP degree, restarts and jitter_pct control the geometry search. For Werner states minimize the exact score; support is the number of nonzero entries per factor, mutate_pct is the percentage of local edits, samples is the trial budget. Use previous attempts to choose a different useful experiment.
